title: FaceTime Hang Up
blurb: A conversation terminated with prejudice, in two flat notes. Apple designed the sound to confirm a call has ended, but the meme usage improves on that considerably. Somebody says something completely unhinged, and this plays. No goodbye, no rebuttal, no explanation — just the void. As a response it may be the politest way ever devised to communicate absolutely not. Devastating when dropped into an edit at the exact moment a take goes too far, and quietly cathartic when used on a real person on purpose.
origin: Apple's FaceTime call-end sound, memed as the ultimate conversation ender.
